slot_scores.name: training_capacity_per_jet
slot_scores.evidence_quote: How many trained pilots does one fighter jet produce per year when it is allocated exclusively for pilot training?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked about the per-year pilot training capacity of one training jet, matching the hidden slot.

slot_scores.name: pilot_to_combat_jet_mapping
slot_scores.rationale: The agent never asked how many combat jets a trained pilot can operate or about the pilot-to-combat-jet relationship.

slot_scores.name: training_duration_and_start
slot_scores.rationale: The agent did not ask when training starts or how many years the training program lasts; it only asked about jet availability and pilot accumulation.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: Training occurs in both year 1 and year 2, with pilots produced in each year and accumulating by the end of year 2.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never confirmed the training start year or duration; it inferred a two-year training/production timeline from the objective and accumulation questions.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent stopped at READY_TO_MODEL while the P1 training duration/start slot remained unresolved and was silently assumed.

summary: The agent recovered the critical P0 training-capacity slot and clarified several operational details, but it never asked about training duration/start and stopped with that P1 slot unresolved, while also omitting the low-impact P2 pilot-to-combat-jet mapping.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
